CustomField.label: Fix Message
CustomField.description: Optional next-step guidance displayed in the detail for a failed check. Tell the user what to review or change, using language that is specific to the failed requirement. Pair it with an Action URL when a useful page, record, report, or playbook can take the user directly to that next step.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional guidance shown after a failure. Give the user a specific next step, such as "Review open Opportunities and their Amount values."
